summary: Processes team-radio network messages during active session phases (1 or 2). When a shared global-state session is referenced, first performs resource-manager frame cleanup and a per-vehicle slot refresh. Then drains incoming messages: SEH-protected data copy off the session interface, message counter reset, driver-index resolution, collision contact solving with the session time, and net-comm dispatch. During an active phase, queued session data is replayed through the ring buffer, otherwise per-entity texture work is gated and a final dispatch is attempted. Raw source is truncated at the per-entity loop body.
